xin-shou-yin-dao-intro: This quick tour covers common entry points and a few hidden features. You can skip anytime and reopen it later in Settings.

onboarding-kuai-su-qie-huan-ye-mian-desc: Home, Discover and Library are the main entry points for recommendations, new music and your collection.
onboarding-sou-suo-yin-le-bu-zhou-desc: Type a song, artist or playlist keyword and press Enter. Search mode can be changed in Settings.
onboarding-zhang-hao-yu-she-zhi-desc: Tap the avatar to sign in, open Settings, check for updates, or view About.
onboarding-bo-fang-kong-zhi-bu-zhou-desc: Use the bottom controls for previous, play/pause and next. Now-playing info is shown here too.
onboarding-geng-duo-bo-fang-gong-neng-de: Favorite, share, change speed and mode, open the queue, and adjust volume here.
onboarding-yong-hu-tiao-kuan-desc: Please read and accept the terms before first use. Agree to continue into the app.
onboarding-qie-huan-tui-jian-ka-pian-des: Tap the Recommendations title to switch between image and icon cards.
onboarding-muses-radio-desc: Quickly play a set of recommended songs when you don’t know what to listen to.
onboarding-qie-huan-dian-tai-lei-xing-de: Switch between personal picks, classics, hot tracks, niche finds and more.
onboarding-pai-hang-bang-ru-kou-desc: Open the charts to quickly browse what’s popular right now.
onboarding-a-jue-jiang-de-ge-dan-desc: This card is the author’s featured playlist on the home page — save it if you like it.
onboarding-mei-ri-tui-jian-yi-jian-jia-r: Add daily picks in one tap
The hidden control beside Daily Recommendations adds the whole set to your queue.
onboarding-mei-ri-tui-jian-ge-qu-desc: Click a song to play it; right-click for more actions.
onboarding-tui-jian-ge-dan-bu-zhou-desc: Browse recommended playlists; open a card for details and playback.
onboarding-fa-xian-ye-fen-lei-desc: Switch between playlists, charts, new albums and new songs.
onboarding-fa-xian-geng-duo-nei-rong-des: Each category loads different content — great for new songs, charts and themed lists.
onboarding-yin-le-ku-zi-liao-ka-desc: Shows your avatar, nickname, level, listening time and follows, and adapts to your profile background.
onboarding-wo-xi-huan-ting-desc: Recently played favorites. Tap the title to add the whole set to your queue.
onboarding-yin-cang-chang-ting-qu-yu-des: A mostly invisible close control appears on hover next to the title — use it to hide this section.
onboarding-yin-le-ku-fen-lei-desc: Switch between created playlists, saved playlists, albums, followed artists and friends.
onboarding-yun-pan-he-ben-di-yin-le-desc: The first two shortcut cards open Cloud Drive and Local Music for managing online and local files.
onboarding-ge-dan-he-shou-cang-nei-rong-: Your created or saved items. Open a card for details, playback and management.
onboarding-chuang-jian-ge-dan-bu-zhou-de: Create a new playlist; the library list refreshes after success.
onboarding-ge-dan-xin-xi-desc: Shows playlist, album or artist info including cover, bio and basics.
onboarding-bo-fang-he-shou-cang-desc: Play the whole list in one tap, or favorite, follow and open more actions.
onboarding-lie-biao-gong-ju-desc: The song list supports batch actions, view switching and in-list search.
onboarding-pi-liang-cao-zuo-bu-zhou-desc: Enable it to select multiple songs for the queue or a playlist.
onboarding-ge-qu-lie-biao-bu-zhou-desc: Click to play, right-click for more actions; headers support sorting.
onboarding-quan-ping-ge-ci-desc: With fullscreen lyrics open, press Ctrl+C or Command+C to copy the current lyrics.
onboarding-qie-huan-chang-pian-mo-shi-de: Tap the left cover to switch between normal and vinyl player mode; it spins while playing.
onboarding-quan-ping-ge-ci-kuai-jie-she-: Hover the arrow on the right to open settings for background, size, highlight and alignment.
onboarding-qie-huan-ge-ci-mo-shi-desc: If translation or romanization exists, this button switches lyrics modes.
onboarding-ge-ci-gun-dong-qu-yu-desc: Lyrics scroll with playback; click a line to jump to that position.
onboarding-tui-chu-quan-ping-ge-ci-desc: Click here or press ESC to exit fullscreen lyrics.
onboarding-she-zhi-fen-lei-desc: On the left, switch between Interface, Sound, Lyrics, Plugins and System.
onboarding-she-zhi-xiang-ka-pian-desc: Each card is a setting. Some changes need a refresh or restart to apply.
onboarding-hui-fu-chu-chang-she-zhi-desc: If settings feel broken, clear local preferences and restore defaults here.
